measurementNotes.cpuQuota: 16 CPUs, cpuset 0-15, memory 24 GiB, one job and one VLM request
measurementNotes.backend: ONNX small models on CPU for both; same Q8_0 VLM on CPU vs Vulkan
measurementNotes.latency: includes preflight, upload, 2-second polling, persistence, normalization, source checks and JSON-LD; not kernel-only timing
measurementNotes.processStart: model already local and OS cache warm; includes container recreation and preload, not disk-cold boot
measurementNotes.warm: Five-format suites have one warmup and three repeats. CPU long warm statistic excludes its first request and combines run-2/run-3 with a supplemental request after DEV-scan-pdf warmup; GPU long reuses its already-warmed service. All process transitions are retained.
measurementNotes.taskCache: unique uploaded filenames and job IDs, no sha256sum reuse option; every request executes hybrid analysis; model/engine caches remain warm
measurementNotes.resources: container cgroup memory includes file cache; GPU board totals and attributed process samples are distinguished; sampling about once per second
measurementNotes.limits: small synthetic sample set, quantized model and shared host; no p95 or general hardware claims
measurementNotes.nativeThreads: Binding uses automatic n_threads; isolated Vulkan diagnostic reported 32 threads. CPU quota/cpuset remain 16 CPUs. Native thread tuning was not performed.

deployment.gpuServiceFinalState: running and healthy; restart and real PNG conversion passed
